_comment: Per-package test coverage ratchet, the Phase 0 CI harness item's coverage policy decision (.SPECIFICATION/IMPLEMENTATION.md). AGENTS.md sets a 90% minimum; the real mean across this repository is far below that (48.2% at the time this file was created), so a flat 90% gate on day one would turn CI red across most of the tree and block all other work. Instead: no package may drop below the floor recorded here (a real regression), 90% is the target for new and touched code going forward, and 'floors' only rises over time as packages improve, never silently down. Generated code and non-shippable tooling are excluded outright, listed in 'excluded' with why, rather than tracked at a floor of 0 (which would hide that they are not expected to ever have their own tests). A package with no entry in either map is new; tools/coverage-check treats that as informational, not a failure, so adding a package never requires a same-commit edit here, but it should get a real entry soon after.

excluded.github.com/SubjectVoidLLC/the-pleiades/c: demo/scratch binary, not the shipped pleiades CLI, not owned by any roadmap phase
excluded.github.com/SubjectVoidLLC/the-pleiades/i: ent schema definitions: declarative field/edge lists with no branching logic of their own, exercised through internal/ent's and internal/inventory's tests, not directly
test-only package (Section 25 layering assertions); no non-test source exists to measure
excluded.github.com/SubjectVoidLLC/the-pleiades/t: test-only package (integration tests); no non-test source exists to measure
excluded.github.com/SubjectVoidLLC/the-pleiades/i: interface-only scaffolding for an unbuilt phase (Section 17 mTLS mesh); no logic exists yet to test
interface-only port definition (transport.Transport); no logic of its own, exercised through internal/transport/ssh

test-double helper package, not shippable product code
